create_custom_hook: create a custom Hook subclass that overrides before_run and after_run methods for training lifecycle
override_epoch_hooks: override before_train_epoch and after_train_epoch in a Hook subclass to add epoch-level logic
override_iter_hooks: override before_train_iter and after_train_iter in a Hook subclass to add iteration-level logic
check_epoch_conditions: use every_n_epochs, is_last_epoch, or end_of_epoch helper methods to conditionally trigger actions
get_triggered_stages: call get_triggered_stages on a Hook instance to list which lifecycle stages are overridden
